title: Kronos cross-language message
description: The shape of a message passed between Luau, Python, native plugins and the host. Values must be JSON-compatible so every language can read them.

event.description: Name of the event, e.g. player.joined

payload.description: Anything JSON can express. Numbers are 64-bit floats. No NaN or infinity. Entities are sent as their numeric id.

trace.description: Correlation id, copied to every message caused by this one, so a chain of calls across languages can be followed in the log.
